sources.title: Qwen-AgentWorld: Language World Models for General Agents
sources.snippet: Figure 1: Overview of Qwen-AgentWorld. Top: Qwen-AgentWorld is a unified native language world model across seven domains. Bottom: We explore two complementary strategies for applying world modeling to enhance language agents (mainly using the 35B-A3B model as agent): Decouple and Unify, where the world model serves as the environment simulator and agent foundation model, respectively.
